public.text: The Client Registry is described as a common first component. In some contexts, a facility registry, workforce registry, product master, terminology foundation, or surveillance use case may provide greater immediate value and face fewer privacy risks.
public.suggestedRevision: Present the Client Registry as a frequent but not default first component. Selection should follow use-case dependencies, risk, data availability, governance readiness, and expected shared value.
